integrity: Statement and computations are independently reproducible from the included proof and standalone scripts; finite checks are corroboration, not a substitute for the all-parameter proof. The dated 2012 preprint is a thematic source-age anchor, not a claim that the present theorem appeared there.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the nilpotent primary partition and the time of first entry to periodicity, not the least periods or individual cycles in the invertible Fitting component. Previously unindexed equivalent work remains possible, especially in the 2010 ladder interlace-polynomial literature.
title: Mod-three reversibility and a two-adic transient census for neighbor-sum dynamics on ladder graphs
